eod.conclusion: Indian benchmarks closed marginally lower after a volatile session, with the Nifty and Sensex dipping slightly while Bank Nifty eked out gains. Early advances were erased as investors turned cautious, though banking stocks showed resilience. The market's inability to hold morning gains reflected ongoing uncertainty, even as some sectors demonstrated relative strength. Global cues and corporate developments remained in focus throughout the trading day.
